title: Stress Reduction Techniques
content: A comprehensive list of stress reduction techniques compiled from various therapy sessions and research from reputable sources. Techniques include mindfulness meditation, progressive muscle relaxation, deep breathing exercises, and engaging in physical activity.

title: Session Notes: Mark Thompson
content: The client has been experiencing increased stress at work and has expressed a desire to learn coping strategies to manage his stress levels. We discussed the benefits of mindfulness and the importance of setting aside time for relaxation.

title: Session Notes: Sarah
content: The client has been dealing with anxiety, particularly in social situations. We explored several techniques to help manage her anxiety, including cognitive-behavioral therapy and exposure therapy. The client has been tasked with practicing these techniques before our next session.
